descriptor.retrieval_description: Flexible foil beverage pouch with printed plastic film laminate. The intended contact region is clean and dry, featuring broad compressible flat panels with soft longitudinal creases and sealed edge fins.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral surfaces of the flexible pouch centered between front and back faces
descriptor.contact_material: Printed plastic film laminate over aluminum foil substrate
descriptor.local_geometry: Broad flexible panels with slight curvature, soft creases, and sealed vertical edge fins
